name: Scattered Flowers
source:
Akihiro and Chiharu were in love with each other. However, they couldn't be together because Chiharu's father was against their relationship. Even so, Akihiro would never give up until her father gave them his blessing, even though that meant he had to gather a thousand flowers overnight!

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/scattered-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
明宏与千春彼此相爱，却因千春父亲的反对而无法厮守。即便如此，明宏在赢得她父亲的祝福之前绝不轻言放弃——哪怕这意味着他必须在一夜之间集齐一千朵鲜花！

[摘自[url=https://altila.itch.io/scattered-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
